description: The main window and every popped-out window (satellite-<id>): create, focus, close and destroy windows for pop-out (a satellite listens for its own close request, so Tauri finishes that close with destroy()); MutaMarket and ceve-market API requests from Rust (neither sends CORS headers); open web links in the system browser; receive the eveauth-visviva ESI login callback and exchange its code
